summary: Alternatives, evaluation and scope, after Charlow's dissertation. An indefinite denotes a set of alternatives in the State.Set monad, which also carries a stack of discourse referents; scope is taken by continuations, with Lift the monad's sequencing and Lower its injection. The monad laws; monadic application; scopal combination subsumes monadic application; binding; Reset leaves an indefinite or a pronoun unchanged and turns a universal into a truth value; an indefinite inside an island scopes over a negation outside it and a universal does not; and an indefinite binds a pronoun in the next sentence. A two-relative model separates the readings.

sources.citation: Charlow, S. (2014). On the semantics of exceptional scope. PhD dissertation, New York University.
sources.available: sections 2.3.3, 2.5.2, 3.2.1-3.2.2, 3.3.2, 3.4-3.5.2, Fact 3.16 and 4.3-4.4.2 read; chapter 5 and the appendices not read

theorems.name: wide_scope_true
theorems.source_claim: Exceptional scope: True is among the returned values (witness r2).

theorems.name: wide_scope_false_too
theorems.source_claim: It is nondeterministic: False is returned too (witness r1).

theorems.name: narrow_scope_false
theorems.source_claim: Narrow scope: negation over the evaluated island returns only False.

theorems.name: universal_trapped
theorems.source_claim: A universal in the island cannot scope over the negation: the only value is True ("not every relative ..."), where the wide-scope universal reading ("every relative did not ...") would be False.

evidence: DRAFT for the author's review; not an accepted source-level verdict.
Equality of programs is pointwise, so no extensionality axiom is used.
Truth values are booleans and negation is a relation: the returned boolean is true exactly when no True is among the argument's values. The source writes a singleton set holding that proposition.
The pronoun returns nothing on the empty stack; the source gives no case for it.
The tower notation, the type system with evaluated types, internal Lift, the Binder Roof Constraint, the conditional case (4.9), plurals, disjunction and chapter 5 are not formalized.

determination_rationale: DRAFT for the author. The monad and the continuation layer transpose directly; lexical verb meanings are arbitrary boolean functions.

artifact_classes.description: pointwise equality in place of equality of functions; booleans as truth values; negation as a relation
